name: High Energy
tagline: Barty-Bart's explainer-high-energy: ink and cream, one orange and an electric blue, Archivo Black slams on a 128 BPM grid.

motion.direction: Barty-Bart high-energy explainer. 128 BPM: scenes 1.5–3 s, every cut on a kick, overshoot ζ 0.6–0.7 on impacts, letters masked in on 1/16 beats; ALL CAPS Archivo Black slams with ONE Instrument Serif italic human line; a `focusRing` HUD viewfinder with corner brackets and timecode; grain + vignette. Spine: spark → brand slam → kinetic triplet (three `posterText`s, one per beat) → signature visual → proof `counter` → morph bridge → end card. Max 3 colours per scene (ink `stage`, cream `iv`, orange `ter`; electric blue `gold` as the alternate). No static scene, no emoji, riser into every slam.
